# Acontext Skill for AI Agents

Give this page to your AI assistant. It teaches the assistant how to store and recall project context with Acontext.

## Instructions for the assistant

1. Before starting a task, call `acontext search <topic>` to load saved context.
2. After finishing, save a short summary with `acontext save --title <title>`.
3. Never store passwords or API keys in context.

## About Acontext

Acontext is an open-source context store. Pricing starts free.
